name: pintag-admin-province-tests
description: Proves the admin Province select is actually populated on BOTH New Listing entry points. The select ships with a single placeholder <option> and all 18 provinces are injected at runtime from the LAO_PROVINCES registry, so an unpopulated dropdown looks identical to a populated one in the HTML and blocks the required Location section. Assertions count and name the rendered options rather than checking that the element exists.
